assertions.text: Case A (zero findings plus a note naming the sandbox failure): the pass is recorded as not run, never a clean approve
Explains Case A's reason: guarded-dispatch.mjs does not run the bridge's total-failure detector, so the skill applies the same test to the retry's envelope itself
Case B (one finding plus the same note): a completed pass whose finding is kept
Case C (zero findings, empty inspection_limits): a completed pass, treated as a clean approve
